name: One date field, four ways of writing a year
name_fr: Un champ de date, quatre façons d'écrire une année

origin.campaign: September 2026 — cleaning journal of the PubMed substrate (Voûte, 17-20 August 2026)

seen.corpus: PubMed baseline frozen 2026-08-18, the publication year as the NLM writes it
seen.document: four shapes in one field: `(AAAA)`, `(AA)`, a bare year, and an interval
seen.observer: Claude Voûte (LLM agent), from 'JOURNAL — comment le corpus est devenu propre', 17-20 August 2026
seen.excerpt: L'extracteur de millésimes trouvait 12,5 % au lieu de 100 % : il n'acceptait que `(AAAA)`, la NLM écrit aussi `(AA)`, des années nues, des intervalles. Révélé par le taux lui-même, absurde.
seen.excerpt_en: The year extractor found 12.5 % instead of 100 %: it accepted only `(AAAA)`, and the NLM also writes `(AA)`, bare years, and intervals. Revealed by the rate itself, which was absurd.

prevention.note: a reader that accepts the shapes the producer actually writes cancels it; what code cannot do is know it is losing them, since a year it cannot read looks the same as a record with no year

repair.note: the value was never read, so there is nothing in the graph to delete

registry_scope.extent: the whole base: the field carries at least four shapes, and a reader built for one of them found 12.5 % of the years
registry_scope.extent_fr: toute la base : le champ porte au moins quatre formes, et un lecteur bâti pour l'une d'elles a trouvé 12,5 % des années
registry_scope.source: read 2026-08-17 on the frozen baseline; cleaning journal of the PubMed substrate

proposed_severity.reason: A reader built for one shape finds the years it knows and is silent about the rest, so the dating of the corpus is complete on a subset and empty elsewhere — and which subset depends on a writing convention, not on the science. Here it cost seven records in eight. It was caught only because a rate of 12.5 % is absurd on its face; a shape covering 90 % would have passed.
proposed_severity.reason_fr: Un lecteur bâti pour une seule forme trouve les années qu'il connaît et se tait sur les autres : la datation du corpus est complète sur un sous-ensemble et vide ailleurs — et quel sous-ensemble dépend d'une convention d'écriture, pas de la science. Ici, sept notices sur huit. Ce n'est passé que parce qu'un taux de 12,5 % est absurde à l'œil ; une forme couvrant 90 % serait passée sans bruit.
proposed_severity.proposed_by: Claude Banc à vérité connue (LLM agent)

history.event: entered 2026-09-13 from the August 2026 cleaning journal of the PubMed substrate. The named object is a file or a declared convention of the PRODUCER — a dictionary, a README, two delivery files, a way of writing a date — and not a record of the corpus: that is what makes it a fault of the registry, with an extent rather than a prevalence. The figure quoted is the journal's own, re-read verbatim.
